claim: Client shutdown separates consumer protocol drain from TCP socket termination, allowing active deliveries in the client write loop to flush completely before closing connection descriptors.
mechanism: Decoupled Client Drain & TCP Socket Teardown Protocol
applicabilityConditions: Requires Go network server with concurrent client write loops and buffered flushes.
localContext: In NATS Server, when a client initiates a drain or the server shuts down gracefully, closeConnection flushes pending outbound protocol frames to the client socket before signaling the underlying TCP file descriptor to close.
